|caption=Icon of the Forge}}'''Ironforge''' is the faction associated with the capital city of the [[Alliance]] dwarves, [[Ironforge]]. King [[Magni Bronzebeard]] rules his kingdom of Khaz Modan from his throne room within the city.

==Reputation==
[[Mistina Steelshield]] has the repeatable cloth quests to achieve a higher reputation with Ironforge. In return for exalted reputation, non-dwarf players are able to ride [[ram]]s.

The zones of [[Dun Morogh]], [[Loch Modan]], [[Wetlands]], [[Stonetalon Mountains]], and [[Alterac Valley]] offer many quests for gaining reputation with Ironforge.

==Rewards==
At honored, [[Hemming Silverbeard]] offers a level 20-27 uncommon leather armor set.

At exalted, Hemming Silverbeard offers a tabard and a unique epic mount, and non-dwarf Alliance races are able to purchase and ride ram mounts (dwarves can ride Ironforge rams regardless of faction reputation).

Ironforge rams are bought from [[Veron Amberstill]] at [[Amberstill Ranch]] in [[Dun Morogh]]. Unarmored rams are available starting at level 40, with armored rams available at level 60.
